subject: Activation Conductor: Ownership & Ops brief for Asterio Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@asteriohealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@asteriohealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Activation Conductor: Ownership & Ops brief for Asterio Health

Quick handoff — summary and asks.

Deal context:
- Account: Asterio Health (mid-market payer-tech). Committed ARR: $96k for Year 1 (Pilot + Production).
- Contract: Dedicated capacity (single-tenant), 12-month term with pilot phase (60 days) then production.
- Expected launch window: pilot kickoff week of 2027-08-08; go-live target for 2027-09-15.

Key constraints / expectations:
- Security: customer requires data residency in us-east and customer-managed SSO via SAML. SOC2 evidence already shared by Sarah.
- Network: VPC peering + egress rules — they will open outbound to our ingress endpoints only.
- Performance: peak concurrency estimated at 40 rps during pilot; production forecast 150 rps with burst to 300 for batch jobs.
- Model: we'll serve a tuned open model variant; they requested 8k context and a pinned model variant (will confirm exact artifact).

Primary asks for CS/Operations:
1) Owner assignment: need a named primary CS lead (day-to-day) and a technical steward for infra questions.
2) Tech intake: Karthik, can you confirm the onboarding checklist items we need to collect from Asterio (SP metadata, IP allowlist, test tenant credentials)?
3) Runbook: upload a concise runbook for SRE/CS handover; I'll attach a draft SOW + runbook for reference.

Attachments: Asterio_SOW_v1.2.pdf (draft), go-live-runbook.xlsx (template).

Next steps: if we can nominate owners by EOD Monday (2027-07-19), I'll lock dates with the customer and start scheduling technical deep-dive sessions.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@asteriohealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation Conductor: Ownership & Ops brief for Asterio Health

Thanks for the clear brief, Ben — stepping in as the activation conductor.

I nominate myself as primary CS lead for the pilot and will hand off to a steady-state CSM (Marissa, want to confirm candidate next week?).
Karthik — would you accept technical steward for infra/network? If yes, please list the exact inbound artifacts you need and an estimated time to validate once we receive them.

I'll prepare a 30/60/90 kickoff outline and propose a pilot milestone cadence (weekly sync + biweekly exec check-ins).

Immediate asks from me to the customer (Sarah/Daniel):
- Please share SAML IdP metadata and a test service account with minimal scopes for initial smoke tests.
- Confirm which subnets will be used for peering and a short maintenance window for the first staging deploy.

I'll pick up the runbook and adapt the attached template; will circulate the first draft by 2027-07-21.

Best — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@asteriohealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@asteriohealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-20T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation Conductor: Ownership & Ops brief for Asterio Health

Happy to take tech steward role. Quick checklist from infra side: 
- SAML IdP metadata (xml) + test user credentials for SSO smoke tests.
- VPC peering info: customer CIDR blocks, expected egress IPs, and any IGW/NAT constraints.
- TLS cert expectations (we support Let's Encrypt for hostnames we manage; customer managed certs OK for private endpoints).
- Sample payloads and expected token volumes (per minute) so we can size the prefork / batching config.

Once we get artifacts I can validate environment readiness in ~48 business hours (assuming no firewall back-and-forth). For the model artifact pin, please confirm the variant name; if they want quantized dist, we need to allow +2 days for kernel validation.

I'll create a short intake form and share the link in the next email.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Platform Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@asteriohealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@asteriohealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation Conductor: Ownership & Ops brief for Asterio Health

Appreciate the quick responses. Per Tessa/Karthik notes — owners now: Tessa (primary CS), Karthik (tech steward), Marissa to nominate steady-state CSM by next Tue (2027-07-26).

Attached: final draft SOW (Asterio_SOW_v1.2.pdf) and a populated runbook (go-live-runbook.xlsx) with tentative dates and an internal validation checklist. DocuSign url below for the SOW once leadership signs off: https://www.docusign.com/signer-link/abc123

External contacts (for recording):
- Sarah Lim — Head of Product, Asterio (sarah.lim@asteriohealth.com)
- Daniel Park — Infrastructure Lead, Asterio (daniel.park@asteriohealth.com)

Open risks flagged:
- SAML metadata delays (risk: 3 days impact to pilot start).
- Peak concurrency may require temporary burst capacity — recommend pre-approve one burst-class for first two weeks of staging.

Action items:
- Tessa: circulate 30/60/90 by 2027-07-21 (in progress).
- Karthik: share intake form + validation ETA (by 2027-07-22).
- Ben: book initial tech deep-dive (2027-07-26) and coordinate DocuSign submission after sign-off.

Thanks team — excited to get Asterio live.

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
